goal.request: Prior researched female-body visual terms were to be encoded as observable candidate-pack semantics and tested by three independent agents using one supplied facial-appearance reference in unrelated complex concepts.

evidence.claim: The referenced research conversation separates anatomical landmarks, fashion boundaries, silhouette transitions, classical composition lines, and body-bounded negative space.
The supplied 1086x1448 JPEG was inspected and used only as a facial-appearance reference.
Twelve approved evidence rows bind anatomical, museum, standards, photographic-perception, and body-value boundaries to concrete candidates and limitations.
Three arms shared only immutable request and reference inputs, used distinct seeds and domains, froze authorial cores before pack inspection, and did not read sibling artifacts.
All photo pipeline tests and focused index, retrieval, scene, and body-semantics checks passed.
evidence.artifact: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_photo_*.py -v => 176 tests OK in 1091.491s; candidate pack 6/6; holdout 22/22; scene audit 112/112

evidence.claim: Arm 1 composed and runtime requests passed while profile surfacing remained candidly limited to candidate-level adoption and an authorial probe.
Arm 2 composed and both runtime requests passed with three post-core visual profiles bound to explicit evidence.
Arm 3 composed and both runtime requests passed with philtral and neutral silhouette profiles bound to explicit evidence.
The urban concept and facial appearance survived, but all three tested semantic units failed strict pixel inspection after one repair.
The three-dimensional Hogarth serpentine profile passed all four gates, while garment ownership prevented strict waist-hip and hourglass qualification.
Seven of nine hard gates passed, but thumbnail upper-lip topology and bilateral silhouette visibility remained unresolved after one repair.
The coordinator independently inspected all three final images at original resolution and agreed with the arm-level success and failure boundaries.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: A selected body-aesthetic term must resolve to observable geometry, ownership, camera or pose conditions, rejected substitutes, and pixel gates that remain legible inside unrelated complex scenes.

invariants.statement: Named aesthetics are represented by visible component relations and false-substitute exclusions rather than aliases alone.
Visible geometry does not authorize health, weight, body-fat, fertility, age, gender, attractiveness, or personal-value inference.
The supplied image controls facial appearance only while person identity, body, clothing, pose, scene, and story remain original.
Each randomized concept and authorial core is frozen before candidate-pack inspection and cannot borrow sibling-arm artifacts.

mismatches.source_state: Counter-tilted pelvis and shoulders plus a continuous arm-waist background triangle were required in the prompt.
mismatches.render_state: The city plan hid the pelvis and filled the arm-waist opening; the shoulders remained nearly level.

mismatches.source_state: Natural waist-hip landmarks and silhouette were to remain separable from coat and belt construction.
mismatches.render_state: The opaque tailored coat and belt remained the dominant visible causes of the contour.

mismatches.axis: thumbnail lip topography and bilateral silhouette
mismatches.source_state: The groove-to-upper-lip arc transition and both torso-waist-hip contours were required to survive review.
mismatches.render_state: The lip relation survived only at native scale and a near arm obscured one silhouette side.

hypotheses.statement: Indirect authorial wording can correctly remain advisory, but may fail to surface a newly added exact profile even when the agent later recognizes a fitting visual relation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Unrelated held-out cores consistently surface the relevant new candidate or profile without exact labels and without false-positive hard obligations.

hypotheses.statement: Props, arms, and garments can satisfy the scene action while simultaneously hiding the body relationship, so semantic evidence needs an explicit occlusion budget at composition time.
hypotheses.falsifier: Held-out renders with equally complex interactions preserve every required body boundary without reserving unoccluded contour space.

hypotheses.statement: Small surface landmarks can be anatomically present at native scale while failing the intended thumbnail contract unless a minimum landmark pixel scale is reserved.
hypotheses.falsifier: Multiple held-out head-to-knees scenes reliably preserve the full philtrum-to-upper-lip topology at thumbnail scale without a tighter crop or larger face.

intervention.general_rule: Encode body semantics as componentized observable relations with explicit ownership, view and pose conditions, request-conditioned adult or appeal gates, rejected substitutes, and thumbnail/native pixel checks; ambiguous shorthand stays fail-closed.
intervention.generalization_basis: The data separates anatomical landmarks, garment boundaries, silhouette transitions, classical pose and composition, and camera-dependent negative space so each can transfer across unrelated scenes without importing one motivating story.

decision.rationale: The implementation is structurally and prompt-level sound and one unrelated semantic profile fully passed pixels, but every arm retained at least one strict render-gate failure after its allowed repair. Render-fidelity promotion and user-aesthetic claims are therefore withheld.
